messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: spike in 5xxs (502/504) across edge-proxy in us-west-2. Alerting on error-rate > 5% over 2m. Rolling page to #incidents.
emma (oncall): ack. i'm on it. seeing a spike starting ~08:33 UTC.
raj (sre): i'm digging into gateway logs. quick note — sampling for request_id is low right now; many entries missing X-Request-Id, makes correlation harder.
sasha (platform): any idea if there's a recent proxy config change? I don't see deploys in last 30m in prod but will check infra events.
emma (oncall): customer impact: some inference requests timing out or returning gateway 502; preliminary telemetry shows tail latency up and request failures for workspace api v1 routes. ramping error budget risk for several paying customers.
tana (support): I've opened a triage ticket and pinged top-5 customers for potential impact window. no escalations yet but they're asking for ETA.
raj (sre): logs: many upstream connections failing with `connect timeout` to model-runners behind the proxy. example log lines:
```
[proxy] 2026-03-14T08:33:52Z WARN upstream connect timeout host=model-runner-17:504
[proxy] 2026-03-14T08:33:52Z ERROR no request_id header
```

raj (sre): problem hypothesis: transient network congestion / bursty load causing connection timeouts between edge-proxy and runner pool. Missing request_id on logs is huge pain for tracing root cause.
sasha (platform): agree. we should enable stopgap higher-granularity logging and inject request_id at the proxy edge for any incoming request so we can trace through. will that increase noise/cost? yes but necessary.
emma (oncall): proposed immediate mitigations (short-lived):
- enable debug logging (proxy) + temporary request_id injection (if header absent, set uuid)
- reduce max connection pooling to runners to avoid head-of-line blocking
- add short-lived curlable health-check to runner group and scale up runners by +20% if errors persist
- fallback routing: route low-priority requests to older model-variant group to reduce pressure

emma (oncall): i'll run the debug toggle and request_id injection now. raj, can you run a grep against traces/runner logs after injection to correlate?
raj (sre): on it. adding a tiny script to tail and join by request_id. sample command i will use:
```
# after injection
grep -R "request_id=" /var/log/proxy/* | sed 's/.*request_id=//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: proxy-config/debug-toggle v2026.3.14-ops. ETA ~45s
sasha (platform): quick config note: toggle will increase log volume ~8-10x. retention for these logs set to 48h — ops-analytics is aware.
ops-analytics: acknowledged, will provision temporary log ingestion buffer and mark these logs as high-priority for retention/ingest.
emma (oncall): live check: after injecting request_id we have traces coming through. correlating 502s -> model-runner timeouts for requests with large input sequences. looks like certain long-context requests are causing runner spike and exhausting connection slots.
raj (sre): mitigation step applied: increased runner pool by 25% on us-west-2 and enabled short backoff in proxy. rolling out now.
emma (oncall): customer impact update: error rate for top customers decreased from 8.2% -> 2.4% in the last 6m after scaling and backoff. still seeing isolated 504s for very long sequences.
tana (support): updated customers: sent note to affected teams, provided ETA for follow-up and highlighted temporary mitigation steps.
emma (oncall): next steps:
- keep debug logging for 1 hour, collect request_id-correlated traces
- engineer follow-up: implement persistent request_id injection in proxy and add request_id to runner logs (sasha + raj)
- evaluate model-runner capacity for long-context heavy requests and create autoscale policy for sequence length signal
- postmortem owner: raj

kelly (next-oncall): thanks — i'll take over the watch window at 09:45 UTC. if error-rate doesn't drop to <1% or we see new deploy-related regressions, raise to Sev2.
raj (sre): noted. leaving a pinned gist with correlation script and sample logs in this thread. also filing a quick instrumentation task: assign to platform-team for request_id header enrichment.
emma (oncall): closing live mitigation loop: primary customer impact reduced. keeping incident open for investigation and instrumentation work. handing off to kelly for the next hour.
incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated (customer-visible errors reduced). Severity downgraded to P3. Pager quieted.
